Zinc cost against galvanizing price: LME zinc over Jun-Aug 2026 against AZZ's pricing discipline is the Metal Coatings margin lever
Precoat Metals: the new Washington, PA facility ramp and any customer/coil-volume commentary. Precoat grew only modestly in Q1, so it is the weaker leg
AVAIL Infrastructure Solutions JV (AZZ's equity stake): equity income and any monetization/IPO news that would change capital allocation
Thin option market (ATM spread 37% of mid, 25d skew +10 vol points toward puts): positioning is set by a small book
